system.description: The mopor reaches out with her arms stretched toward the sky and calls upon Sille. The mopor’s hands then begin to glow with a purifying fire that the mopor lowers toward an injured character. Scar tissue immediately appears over the places where the fire has purified the body. ✦ Heals 10 Body Points and stops any bleeding.
system.summary: Accelerates the natural healing of an injured creature's wounds.

powerLevels.effect: Increase the power's duration by 1 day
Increase healing rate by +1 Body Point per day
